articles.title: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets to expand institutional crypto business
articles.snippet: The deal adds institutional trading clients, derivatives expertise and regulatory licenses as Keyrock looks to deepen its presence in crypto capital markets.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Strengthening defenses against AI fraud
Ledger wants AI agents to manage crypto without holding your keys
articles.snippet: AI agents can read wallet balances and analyze portfolios but requires every sensitive action to be approved on a Ledger hardware device before it can be executed.

articles.title: Bitcoin pulls back to $64,000 after hitting monthly high as bears take control
articles.snippet: Profit-taking after bitcoin hit a $65,500 monthly high combined with fresh Iranian strikes on U.S. bases sent crypto lower, with bears leading price action across most tokens.

articles.title: BitPay secures Dutch licensing under MiCA, plans to expand stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: The Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets approved BitPay’s application as a crypto-asset service provider under the Markets in Crypto-Assets requirements.
